title: Protesters clash with Rahul Gandhi during Bharat Summit in Hyderabad

ai.summary: Protesters clashed with Rahul Gandhi during his Bharat Summit visit in Hyderabad, as Telangana BJP Yuva Morcha members tore his posters and criticized his presence at a state-funded event, calling it a Congress affair. Police detained several protesters amid the unrest.
